一先ず: for now; for the time being; for the present
追い付く: to catch up (with); to draw level; to pull even; to reach
攫う: to carry off; to run away with; to sweep away; to snatch
逃がす: to miss (e.g. a chance); to lose; to let get away; to fail to catch
振る: to turn down (someone); to reject; to jilt; to dump
捕まる: to hold on to; to grasp
整える: to get ready; to prepare; to arrange; to supply
盛り上げる: to stir up; to enliven; to bring to a climax
正解: right decision; right choice; appropriate judgement
引っ張る: to take someone somewhere (e.g. a suspect to the police)
野兎: hare (esp. the Japanese hare, Lepus brachyurus)
生かす: to let live; to keep alive
絶縁: breaking off relations (with); severing one's connections (with); breaking with (e.g. one's past)
救う: to rescue (someone); to save; to help (out of a difficulty); to relieve (from)
許す: to forgive; to pardon; to excuse; to tolerate
預ける: to leave (in someone's keeping); to put (in someone's care); to place (in someone's custody); to entrust (someone) with
詰まる: to come to the end; to be settled

__flags__.野兎: 他やと = 他+や+と (copula や + と), not 'hare'
__flags__.食: 食えん男 = 食う negative (slippery/hard-to-handle man), 食える+ん, not noun 食
__flags__.括る: 腹くくる = idiom 'steel oneself/resolve', not literally 'hang oneself'
__flags__.詰まる: つまんねえ = つまらない 'boring', not 詰まる (Kansai/casual 'tsumaranai' sense)
